subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_spawn child runs fail after acceptance with HTTP 401 Missing scopes api.responses.write

question: Should native `sessions_spawn` child runs inherit the requester session's effective provider/model/auth profile by default, or should they require an explicit supported child route and fail before acceptance when that route cannot execute?
rationale: The current code/docs mismatch and the open PRs show multiple plausible repair shapes, but choosing the auth/runtime inheritance and accepted-versus-preflight failure contract changes user-visible provider routing behavior.

options.title: Define Native Inheritance Contract
options.body: Make child runs inherit the requester effective route/auth state unless a configured or explicit child model overrides it, and fail before acceptance when the chosen route is not executable.

options.title: Land Split Narrow Fixes
options.body: Review and land separate canonical PRs for explicit model forwarding and requester-model inheritance, then rerun this issue's OpenAI OAuth path before closing it.

options.title: Treat As OAuth Scope Only
options.body: Resolve only the OpenAI OAuth scope issue and leave native subagent inheritance unchanged, accepting that this issue may need a separate follow-up if child context still diverges.

recommendation.title: Define Native Inheritance Contract
recommendation.body: Make child runs inherit the requester effective route/auth state unless a configured or explicit child model overrides it, and fail before acceptance when the chosen route is not executable.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is in subagent spawn planning and model-selection ownership where recent history points to steipete.
